vars.label: Hospitals (Medicare-certified)
vars.definition: Hospitals in CMS's Hospital General Information list for the municipality of the hospital: acute care, psychiatric, children's and the VA hospital that Medicare certifies or rates. Hospitals that do not take part in Medicare are not listed. A municipality with none shows 0: CMS lists none there. Names and addresses are not kept.

vars.label: Hospitals with an emergency department
vars.definition: Hospitals of CMS's Hospital General Information list that say they provide emergency services, in the municipality of the hospital. A municipality with none shows 0. Names and addresses are not kept.

vars.label: Dialysis facilities
vars.definition: Dialysis facilities certified by Medicare (CMS's Dialysis Facility list), in the municipality CMS gives for the facility. A municipality with none shows 0: CMS lists none there. Names and addresses are not kept.

vars.label: Nursing homes (Medicare or Medicaid certified)
vars.definition: Nursing homes certified by Medicare or Medicaid (CMS's Nursing Home list), in the municipality CMS gives. Long-term care homes that are not certified are not listed. A municipality with none shows 0: CMS lists none there. Names and addresses are not kept.

vars.label: Home health agencies
vars.definition: Home health agencies certified by Medicare (CMS's Home Health Care Agencies list), in the municipality of the agency's office; an agency serves people in other municipalities too. A municipality with none shows 0: CMS lists none there. Names and addresses are not kept.

vars.label: Hospice providers
vars.definition: Hospice providers certified by Medicare (CMS's Hospice list), in the municipality of the provider's office; hospice care is mostly given at home, in any municipality the provider serves. A municipality with none shows 0: CMS lists none there. Names and addresses are not kept.

vars.label: Road distance to the nearest health center (average per resident, km)
vars.ref: Computed by the observatory from HRSA's sites, the 2020 census blocks and OpenStreetMap roads (care_access.py)
vars.definition: Measured from where people live: each 2020 census block with residents, from its internal point to the nearest permanent health center site (HRSA's list), along the roads in either direction, and averaged over the municipality's residents. It is a distance to the nearest health center, not to a hospital, an emergency department or a doctor's office, and it says nothing about hours, services or whether the center takes a person's insurance. An estimate made by the observatory, not a figure HRSA publishes.

vars.label: Drive time to the nearest health center (estimate, minutes)
vars.ref: Computed by the observatory from HRSA's sites, the 2020 census blocks and OpenStreetMap roads (care_access.py)
vars.definition: Measured from where people live: each 2020 census block with residents, from its internal point to the nearest permanent health center site (HRSA's list), along the roads in either direction, and averaged over the municipality's residents. It is a distance to the nearest health center, not to a hospital, an emergency department or a doctor's office, and it says nothing about hours, services or whether the center takes a person's insurance. Drive time uses the observatory's planning speeds for each class of road (free flow: no traffic, no stops, no waiting): a rough estimate that is shorter than most real trips. The road distance is the firmer figure.

vars.label: Residents within 10 km of a health center by road (%)
vars.ref: Computed by the observatory from HRSA's sites, the 2020 census blocks and OpenStreetMap roads (care_access.py)
vars.definition: Measured from where people live: each 2020 census block with residents, from its internal point to the nearest permanent health center site (HRSA's list), along the roads in either direction, and averaged over the municipality's residents. It is a distance to the nearest health center, not to a hospital, an emergency department or a doctor's office, and it says nothing about hours, services or whether the center takes a person's insurance. The share of the municipality's residents whose road distance to the nearest health center site is 10 km or less. An estimate made by the observatory.

cms_provider_data.note: Medicare-certified facilities. The observatory publishes counts for each municipality, never names, addresses or certification numbers.
